(b) `FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL ()`: the grammar's optional functionArgList is absent, same arity error. (c) `FUNCTION TEST-NUMVAL (1:4)`: intercepted BEFORE the bind by IntrinsicBinder.cs:87 (FNARG_LPAREN null + refModPart present + DefinitionPermitsArguments, which is MaxArgs > 0 = true here), so it draws the §8.4.3.2.3 SR6 message COBOL1543, not a misleading "takes 1 argument(s); 0 given" — the PB61 misroute does not reach this function. I also confirmed TEST-NUMVAL is NOT diverted to any bespoke binder (BindNumvalCFamily takes "NUMVAL-C" or "TEST-NUMVAL-C" only, line 557), so the generic arity + class path at 565-581 is the ONE path, and PB12's "bespoke binders return above CheckArgumentClasses" hazard does not apply.
